q: 1. *As per ICAO recommendation minimum width of safety area for instrumental runway should is:
explain: For instrument runways, ICAO recommends a minimum safety area width of 300 meters.

q: 2. *For A,B and C types of airports, longitudinal gradient of the runway recommended by ICAO is :
explain: ICAO recommends a maximum longitudinal gradient of 1.5% for major airport categories (A, B, C).

q: 3. *In FY 2072/73, various accidents were occured and there was a heavy losses of lives in Nepal. Among the various airports which of the following is most dangerous in Nepal.
explain: Tenzing-Hillary (Lukla) Airport is considered one of the most dangerous due to terrain and short runway.

q: 4. *Windrose diagram of Tribhuvan International Airport indicates that the runway is oriented as
explain: TIA's runway is oriented roughly North-South, designated as 02 and 20.

q: 5. *A domestic airport is an airport that handles only
explain: Domestic airports serve only internal flights within the same country.
ICAO provides classification standards for runway geometry, length, and pavement strength.

q: 7. According to the I.C.A.O. the runway lengths of aerodromes, have been coded by ............
explain: ICAO uses the first few letters (A, B, C, D, E) or numbers (1, 2, 3, 4) depending on the specific code (Reference Code). Answer key marks 'c'.

q: 8. Which one airpot come in operation from 2022 AD ?
explain: Gautam Buddha International Airport (GBIA) officially began international operations in May 2022.

q: 9. According to the I.C.A.O. the strength of runway pavements, have been coded by ............
explain: The ACN-PCN system (or LCN) uses numeric values and code letters for strength. Answer key marks 'd'.

q: 10. The maximum length and pavement strength of the runway is that of ............
explain: Category 'A' represents the longest runway length and '1' represents the highest pavement strength in this specific code format.

q: 11. Two single runway may be arranged so as to have ............
explain: Multiple runways can be oriented in parallel, intersecting (X), or diverging (L/T) patterns depending on wind rose requirements.

q: 12. The I.C.A.O. has two governing bodies named ............
explain: Technically ICAO has an Assembly and a Council. Answer key marks 'a' based on local PSC terminology variations.

q: 13. The marking of taxiway is yellow while on apron is ............
explain: Both taxiway and apron markings (lead-in lines, parking positions) are generally yellow.

q: 14. The colour of wind direction indicator is ............
explain: Wind cones (windsocks) are typically high-visibility orange or red, sometimes alternating with white stripes.

q: 15. The bearing of the runway at threshold is 290°, the runway number is ............
explain: Runway numbering is the magnetic bearing rounded to the nearest 10 degrees and divided by 10. $290 / 10 = 29$.

q: 16. If the visibility of environment is less than 4 kNm then pilot must follow ............
explain: If visibility is below VFR minima (Visual Flight Rules), the pilot must operate under IFR (Instrument Flight Rules).

q: 17. The best direction of a runway is along the direction of ............
options: longest line on wind rose diagram
shortest line on wind rose diagram
line clear of wind rose diagram
explain: The longest line (spoke) on a wind rose diagram indicates the direction of prevailing winds, which is the ideal orientation for a runway.
